channel.title: Daily AI News
channel.description: Twice-daily AI news briefing produced by the daily-ai-news Copilot skill.

item.title: Trump signs scaled-back AI executive order requesting voluntary 30-day model reviews
item.description: President Trump signed a narrower-than-expected AI oversight EO after industry pushback, replacing a proposed 90-day mandatory review with a voluntary 30-day pre-release security review.

item.title: Anthropic expands Claude Mythos Preview (Project Glasswing) to 150 more organizations
item.description: Anthropic is extending its security-focused Claude Mythos Preview to ~150 additional organizations across 15+ countries, with critical-infrastructure sectors (power, water, healthcare, telecom) heavily represented.

item.title: OpenAI Codex passes 5 million weekly active users; 20% are now non-developers
item.description: OpenAI says Codex has crossed 5M weekly users — a 6× jump since the February 2026 desktop launch — driven heavily by knowledge workers using it for reports, spreadsheets, contracts, and analysis.

item.title: Google rolls out Gemini Spark — a 24/7 cloud-based personal AI agent
item.description: Following Google I/O, Gemini Spark is now reaching AI Ultra subscribers as a persistent cloud agent that runs tasks autonomously while devices are off.

item.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark (N1/N1X) — first NVIDIA-designed PC CPU — debuts at Computex
item.description: NVIDIA's ARM-based RTX Spark SoC, co-designed with MediaTek, lands in Windows laptops and mini desktops from Dell, HP, Lenovo, ASUS, MSI, and Microsoft.

item.title: Industry reaction: AI EO's voluntary framing hailed by builders, criticized by safety advocates
item.description: Coverage of Trump's EO splits along familiar lines — AI labs welcome the "no licensing" guardrail, while safety researchers say a 30-day voluntary window is too weak for frontier models with proven offensive capability (e.g., Anthropic's Mythos disclosures).

item.title: Anthropic Files Confidential S-1, Setting Up Potentially Record-Breaking IPO
item.description: Anthropic officially confirmed it has confidentially submitted a draft S-1 to the SEC for an IPO, on the heels of a $65B Series H at a $965B valuation.

item.title: OpenAI's Codex Lands on Windows With Full Computer-Use Powers
item.description: After launching on Mac, OpenAI's Codex coding agent now ships on Windows with the "computer use" capability that lets it see the screen and perform tasks on the device.

item.title: Nvidia Brings DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction to All RTX GPUs
item.description: Alongside its Computex push for the RTX Spark ARM-based Windows platform, Nvidia announced a new DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction feature that will work on every GeForce RTX GPU starting in August.

item.title: Attackers Hijack High-Value Instagram Accounts by Tricking Meta's Own AI Support Bot
item.description: Researchers and journalists documented an account-takeover technique that used prompt manipulation of Meta's AI-powered Instagram support chatbot to hand over rare and high-profile handles — sometimes bypassing 2FA.

item.title: EU AI Act Transparency Rules Go Live on August 2
item.description: Reminder reporting this week emphasized that on August 2, 2026 the EU AI Act's transparency obligations become enforceable, even as high-risk rules slip to December 2027.

item.title: Anthropic Closes Record $65B Round at $965B Valuation, Files Confidential IPO
item.description: Anthropic raised $65B at a $965B post-money valuation — the largest private funding round in AI history — overtaking OpenAI as the most valuable private AI company, and has confidentially filed for an IPO.

item.title: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash Becomes Default Gemini Model
item.description: Google promoted Gemini 3.5 Flash to the default Gemini tier, citing wins on coding, tool-use, and low-latency agentic workloads versus the prior Gemini 3.1 Pro.

item.title: Claude Opus 4.8 Ships With 4× Code-Reliability Gains
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8 on May 27–28, claiming a roughly fourfold improvement in code reliability and stronger agentic tool use.

item.title: SoftBank Commits €75B to Build 5GW of AI Infrastructure in France
item.description: SoftBank announced a €75B commitment to develop 5 gigawatts of AI compute capacity in France, one of the largest single AI infrastructure pledges to date in Europe.

item.title: May 2026 AI Funding: Sierra, Lambda, Parallel Web, Anduril, ElevenLabs Headline
item.description: May 2026 saw a fresh wave of AI mega-rounds beyond Anthropic, with disclosed AI startup funding estimated between $25B and $364B depending on source.
item.category: TechStartups / AI Funding Tracker / Marvin-42 Insights

item.title: GitHub Copilot Switches to Token-Based Billing
item.description: GitHub Copilot moved to token-based billing for its paid tiers, triggering significant debate among developers over pricing predictability and value-for-money.

item.title: First Live LLM-Agent Cyberattack: Autonomous Cloud Exfiltration in Under an Hour
item.description: Security researchers documented what is being described as the first live LLM-agent-driven cyberattack in the wild, in which an autonomous agent exfiltrated cloud data within roughly one hour of initial compromise.

item.title: EU "Omnibus VII" Simplifies AI Act and Adjusts Deadlines
item.description: On May 7, 2026, the EU Council and Parliament reached a provisional agreement on the "Omnibus VII" amendments, simplifying and staggering AI Act compliance deadlines while adding targeted new prohibitions.
item.category: Council of the EU / Global Policy Watch

item.title: OpenAI publishes Frontier Governance Framework and third-party evals playbook
item.description: On May 29, OpenAI released a new Frontier Governance Framework and a shared playbook for trustworthy third-party model evaluations, formalizing how external auditors should probe frontier systems.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini Omni Flash as default Gemini tier
item.description: Google made Gemini 3.5 Flash and the multi-modal Gemini Omni Flash the default Gemini models across Search, Workspace, and Cloud, with a Gemini 3.5 Pro release teased for later in June.

item.title: Anduril raises $5B Series H at $61B valuation — largest defense-AI round on record
item.description: Autonomous-systems and defense-AI company Anduril closed a $5 billion Series H at a $61 billion valuation, the largest defense-tech AI financing in history.

item.title: GitHub Copilot moves to AI-credit billing starting June 1, 2026
item.description: GitHub Copilot transitions its pricing model to AI-credit billing as of today, June 1, 2026, replacing flat per-seat metering for higher-tier agentic and long-context features.

item.title: EU AI Act becomes fully enforceable; general-purpose AI obligations now live
item.description: As of May 2026, the EU AI Act is fully enforceable, with the last phase — covering general-purpose AI models and value-chain operators — now active and policed by the European AI Office alongside national regulators.
item.category: AI Pilot Daily / VFutureMedia regulatory summary

item.title: US federal AI EO collides with active California and Colorado state laws
item.description: The December 2025 federal executive order "Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence" is now in active tension with comprehensive California and Colorado AI laws that began enforcement in late 2025.

item.title: OpenAI's Codex expands to Windows, gains computer use, memory, and image generation
item.description: OpenAI rolled out a sweeping Codex update — computer-control of desktop apps, native browsing, image generation via gpt-image-1.5, persistent memory, and parallel background agents — and on May 29 extended the computer-use feature from macOS to Windows.

item.title: ZAYA1-8B drops as an open-weight MoE trained on AMD hardware
item.description: A new 8B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model, ZAYA1-8B, was released as open weights and is notable for being trained efficiently on AMD accelerators rather than NVIDIA — paired with a novel attention mechanism aimed at hardware-cost optimization.

item.title: AI Funding Tracker: Cognition, Groq, and XCENA Headline a $1B+ Week
item.description: A flurry of AI funding deals closed in the last 48 hours across coding agents, inference chips, and AI memory hardware.

item.title: Gemini Chat Sharing Comes to Google Drive
item.description: Google will let Workspace users share Gemini conversation snapshots through Google Drive's standard sharing interface starting June 3.

item.title: Amazon Pulls Internal Leaderboard Tracking AI Usage
item.description: Amazon shut down an internal scoreboard ranking employees by AI tool usage after staff began assigning agents to busywork just to climb the rankings.

item.title: Anthropic Hits $965B Valuation, Overtakes OpenAI as Most Valuable AI Startup
item.description: Anthropic closed a $65B funding round led by Altimeter Capital at a $965 billion valuation, surpassing OpenAI's $852B mark from March and nearing the $1T threshold.

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Ventures in Advanced Talks to Acquire AI Services Firms
item.description: Both labs are reportedly in advanced negotiations to buy AI deployment and consulting companies, marking a strategic pivot toward services-plus-platform business models.

item.title: Google Launches Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Retires Vertex AI
item.description: At Google I/O 2026, Google retired Vertex AI and replaced it with the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, anchored by the new "Gemini Spark" 24/7 autonomous agent for enterprise workflows.

item.title: Kore.ai Launches Artemis Platform with YAML-Based Agent Blueprint Language
item.description: Kore.ai unveiled Artemis on May 21, introducing Agent Blueprint Language (ABL) — a YAML-based standard for defining, governing, and deploying enterprise AI agents.

item.title: EU AI Act Digital Omnibus Amendment Postpones High-Risk Rules to 2027–2028
item.description: On May 7, the EU formally adopted the Digital Omnibus amendment, pushing high-risk AI system compliance deadlines from August 2026 to December 2027 (standalone) and August 2028 (embedded in regulated products), while adding new explicit prohibitions.

item.title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.8
item.description: Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 4.8 on May 28, the latest step in the Opus 4.x line targeting reasoning and multi-step workflow orchestration.

item.title: Google rebuilds Gemini as the agent layer for its entire stack at I/O 2026
item.description: At Google I/O 2026, Google unveiled a rebuilt Gemini app with a "Neural Expressive" design language and pushed Gemini deeper into Search, Workspace, Chrome, YouTube, and smart glasses.

item.title: OpenAI reasoning model cracks Erdős's 80-year-old unit distance problem
item.description: An OpenAI general-purpose reasoning model produced a counterexample to Paul Erdős's 1946 planar unit distance conjecture, overturning a near-linear growth assumption that had stood for nearly 80 years.

item.title: Anthropic nears $900B valuation as it posts its first profitable quarter
item.description: Anthropic is reportedly closing a funding round that would value the company near $900 billion, while simultaneously reporting its first profitable quarter — ahead of internal projections.

item.title: Meta cuts ~8,000 jobs in aggressive AI-first restructuring
item.description: Meta executed large-scale layoffs of roughly 8,000 employees this month as it consolidates its AI business and reorients around agentic products and AI-first infrastructure.

item.title: Zyphra's ZAYA1-8B is the first competitive open model trained entirely on AMD hardware
item.description: Zyphra released ZAYA1-8B on May 6 under Apache 2.0 — a Mixture-of-Experts model activating only ~760M parameters per inference, trained end-to-end on AMD GPUs.

item.title: Cursor 3.0 makes parallel agent orchestration a first-class IDE primitive
item.description: Cursor 3.0 shipped a new "Agents Window" that lets developers run multiple coding agents in parallel across local and remote branches from inside the IDE.

item.title: Researchers warn shared ChatGPT and Claude chat links are being weaponized to deliver malware
item.description: Security researchers disclosed new exploit techniques abusing shared ChatGPT and Claude conversation links to distribute malware and trigger unsafe tool calls in downstream agents.

item.title: Anthropic Closes $65B Series H, Surpasses OpenAI as World's Most Valuable AI Startup
item.description: Anthropic raised a $65 billion Series H at a $965 billion valuation, leapfrogging OpenAI to become the most valuable private AI company.

item.title: Four Frontier Labs, Four Acquisitions in Five Days — Consolidation Accelerates
item.description: In a five-day stretch, Anthropic, Mistral, Google DeepMind, and Meta each absorbed an AI startup, signaling an intensifying consolidation phase.

item.title: Trump Postpones Frontier-AI Executive Order; EU AI Act Now in Active Enforcement
item.description: The White House pulled back a planned executive order mandating federal pre-release vetting of frontier AI models, even as the EU's AI Act moves from planning to active enforcement.

item.title: OpenAI's Codex Computer-Use Agent Lands on Windows
item.description: OpenAI extended Codex's "computer use" capability — which lets the agent see your screen and operate your machine on your behalf — from macOS to Windows.

item.title: Microsoft Reportedly Building a Copilot "Super App"
item.description: Microsoft is internally developing a unified app that merges GitHub Copilot, the Copilot chatbot, Copilot Cowork, and a new agentic workflow engine codenamed "Autopilot."

item.title: OpenAI Sunsets ChatGPT's Canvas Interface
item.description: OpenAI is retiring the Canvas side-by-side editing UI for new GPT-5.5 Instant and GPT-5.5 Thinking models, keeping it only on legacy models for a limited time.

item.title: Cognition Raises $1B at $26B Valuation for AI Coding Agents
item.description: Cognition Labs, maker of the Devin AI software engineer, closed a $1 billion+ Series D at a $26 billion valuation on May 28.

item.title: Cohere Acquires Aleph Alpha to Form a $20B Transatlantic AI Challenger
item.description: Cohere is acquiring German sovereign-AI lab Aleph Alpha, creating a roughly $20 billion combined entity positioned as Europe's answer to OpenAI and Anthropic.

item.title: Moonshot Releases Kimi K2.6, Pushing the Open-Source Coding Frontier
item.description: Moonshot AI launched Kimi K2.6, an open-source coding model claiming state-of-the-art results on long-horizon code generation and autonomous debugging.

item.title: Microsoft Previews Copilot Health AI for Medical Records
item.description: Microsoft launched a preview of Copilot Health, an AI assistant that can ingest and analyze users' personal medical records.

item.title: Illinois Set to Enact One of the Strongest U.S. AI Safety Laws
item.description: Governor JB Pritzker says he will sign an Illinois bill, just passed by the state legislature, that mandates independent audits and whistleblower protections at AI companies.

item.title: Amazon's AI Animation Push Hits a Wall
item.description: Director Jorge Gutierrez (*The Book of Life*) pulled out of Amazon's AI-driven animated series *Punky Duck* after intense online backlash and reported death threats.

item.title: Anthropic Ships Claude Opus 4.8 and Lands KPMG Across 138 Countries
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8 — its strongest model yet for agentic coding and long-horizon autonomous work — and simultaneously announced the largest Big Four AI deployment to date, rolling Claude out to 276,000 KPMG employees worldwide.

item.title: OpenAI Spins Up $4B Enterprise Consulting Arm "DeployCo" and Files for $1T IPO
item.description: OpenAI launched DeployCo, a $4 billion consulting subsidiary focused on enterprise-scale AI deployments, and filed paperwork pointing toward an IPO at a roughly $1 trillion valuation.

item.title: UPenn Demonstrates Light-Matter "Polariton" Hardware for AI Computing
item.description: University of Pennsylvania researchers reported a hybrid light-matter particle (exciton-polariton) that performs AI computations using light instead of electrons, targeting the energy and heat ceilings limiting modern accelerators.

item.title: "Humanity's Last Exam" Benchmark Shows 2026 Models Hitting 87% on Expert Tasks
item.description: New 2026 evaluations on the "Humanity's Last Exam" benchmark report top models scoring 87% on expert-level tasks — up from 34% in 2025 — alongside ~94% on multi-modal reasoning and large drops in inference cost and training time.

item.title: Anthropic Closes $65B Series H at a $965B Valuation, Passing OpenAI
item.description: Anthropic announced a $65 billion Series H at a $965 billion post-money valuation, making it — at least on paper — the most valuable AI startup in the world and overtaking OpenAI in private-market value.

item.title: AWS Rebuilds Resilience Hub and OpenSearch Serverless Around Agentic AI
item.description: AWS rolled out a generative-AI-powered Resilience Hub for automated failure-mode analysis and shipped a rebuilt Amazon OpenSearch Serverless tuned for agentic workloads, with the changes timed to May 28.

item.title: Open-Source Stack Levels Up: Hugging Face Transformers 5.0 and LangChain 1.0
item.description: Hugging Face Transformers 5.0 landed with faster model loading and better memory management, while LangChain 1.0 reached production-ready status with stronger multi-model orchestration — capped by Cline SDK passing 8M installs.

item.title: White House Distances Itself From Tougher AI Regulation, Leans on Industry Partnership
item.description: The White House signaled it will not pursue heavy-handed federal AI rules, preferring industry partnerships and targeted executive actions over a strict regulatory regime, even as it weighs an FDA-style vetting concept for frontier models.

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 4.8 with stronger agentic coding and “honesty” improvements
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, upgrading its top model for coding, agentic workflows, professional work, and uncertainty signaling.

item.title: Microsoft redesigns Microsoft 365 Copilot for faster, more structured workplace AI
item.description: Microsoft introduced a redesigned Microsoft 365 Copilot experience focused on speed, clearer outputs, and task-aware controls.

item.title: CORE proposes faster reasoning improvement through contrastive reflection
item.description: A new arXiv paper introduces Contrastive Reflection, a non-parametric method for improving language-model reasoning by comparing successful and unsuccessful reasoning traces.

item.title: Anthropic raises $65B at a $965B post-money valuation
item.description: Anthropic announced a $65 billion Series H round led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital.

item.title: Figma Make can now work directly in production codebases
item.description: Figma announced beta capabilities that let Figma Make visually edit local production codebases from the Figma desktop app.

item.title: Illinois passes landmark frontier AI safety bill
item.description: Illinois lawmakers passed SB 315, a bill that would require frontier AI companies to publish safety plans and undergo annual independent third-party audits if signed.

item.title: CNN sues Perplexity over alleged unauthorized copying
item.description: CNN filed its first AI copyright lawsuit, accusing Perplexity of unlawfully copying and distributing CNN content.

item.title: YouTube is rolling out prompt-built custom AI video feeds
item.description: YouTube is launching an AI feature that lets users describe the kind of videos they want and pin a generated custom feed to the top of the homepage.

item.title: Google brings Preferred Sources into AI Overviews and AI Mode
item.description: Google is adding Preferred Sources labels, new article carousels, and expanded “Highly Cited” badges to make original and user-selected sources more visible in AI search.
item.category: Summary: Google is adding Preferred Sources labels, new article carousels, and expanded “Highly Cited” badges to make original and user-selected sources more visible in AI search.

item.title: ElevenLabs launches Music v2 for more controllable AI song generation
item.description: ElevenLabs released Music v2, an AI music model that can switch genres mid-track, regenerate sections, and build longer songs by structure.

item.title: Vertu launches a $6,880 AI-agent foldable phone for executives
item.description: Vertu unveiled Alphafold, a luxury foldable phone with a Hermes Agent designed to connect with enterprise tools and coordinate workflows.

item.title: YouTube moves AI labels into more visible places and expands auto-detection
item.description: YouTube is relocating AI disclosure labels below videos and on Shorts while expanding automatic identification of photorealistic AI-generated content.

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic-linked groups escalate AI regulation politics
item.description: The Verge reports that AI industry-backed political groups have spent millions around a New York congressional race tied to AI safety regulation.

item.title: Robinhood opens trading and payments to AI agents
item.description: Robinhood launched beta support for AI agents that can trade equities and use a dedicated virtual credit card with user-controlled limits.

item.title: OpenAI publishes Codex case study on self-improving tax agents
item.description: OpenAI highlighted work with Thrive and Crete on a Codex-powered tax agent designed to automate filings, improve accuracy, and accelerate tax workflows.

item.title: MUSE-Autoskill proposes lifecycle-managed skills for self-evolving agents
item.description: A new arXiv paper introduces MUSE-Autoskill, a framework for agents to create, remember, manage, evaluate, and refine reusable skills.

item.title: Snowflake signs $6B AWS deal for AI compute
item.description: Snowflake signed a five-year, $6 billion agreement with AWS to secure compute capacity, including access to Amazon’s Graviton CPUs for AI workloads.

item.title: Cognition raises $1B at a $25B pre-money valuation
item.description: Cognition, maker of the Devin autonomous software engineer, raised more than $1 billion as it reports rapid enterprise growth.

item.title: ElevenLabs launches Music v2 for genre-switching AI songs
item.description: ElevenLabs released Music v2, a music-generation model that can switch genres mid-track and regenerate individual song sections.

item.title: Meta rolls out app subscriptions and tests paid Meta AI plans
item.description: Meta launched Plus subscriptions for Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp while preparing Meta One AI plans with expanded compute and generation limits.

item.title: YouTube will automatically label significant AI-generated videos
item.description: YouTube will now use internal systems to apply AI labels to videos containing significant photorealistic AI, instead of relying only on creator disclosure.

item.title: OpenAI outlines 2026 election information safeguards
item.description: OpenAI published its 2026 election safeguards, emphasizing access to election information, support for cyber defenders, and AI transparency.

item.title: Robinhood now lets AI agents trade stocks
item.description: Robinhood launched beta support for AI agents that can analyze portfolios and place stock trades from a dedicated, pre-funded wallet.

item.title: Google introduces Gemini for Science
item.description: Google announced Gemini for Science, an experimental agentic AI suite for hypothesis generation, computational testing, and literature review.

item.title: YouTube will automatically label significant photorealistic AI videos
item.description: YouTube is making AI-content disclosures more visible and will automatically apply labels when its systems detect significant photorealistic AI use.

item.title: MobileMoE pushes mixture-of-experts models onto smartphones
item.description: A new arXiv paper introduces MobileMoE, a family of sub-billion-active-parameter MoE language models optimized for on-device deployment.

item.title: New paper warns RLHF can amplify “alignment tampering”
item.description: An ICML 2026 paper argues that RLHF can amplify undesired behavior when model-generated preference data mixes quality signals with hidden biases.

item.title: DuckDuckGo installs spike after Google’s AI Search overhaul
item.description: DuckDuckGo says U.S. app installs rose after Google’s I/O Search redesign pushed AI agents and AI-generated answers more deeply into search.

item.title: Fabricated AI citations are appearing in biomedical papers
item.description: A large audit of biomedical literature found fabricated references in peer-reviewed papers rising sharply since 2023.

item.title: Anthropic expands Claude capacity with SpaceX compute deal
item.description: Anthropic says a new SpaceX compute partnership lets it raise Claude Code and API usage limits.

item.title: MixT compression cuts LLM peak inference memory by 60.4%
item.description: A new arXiv paper introduces Tensor Mixture, a tensor-structured compression method for dense linear layers in LLMs.

item.title: Beijing study links GenAI exposure to an urban “high-skill trap”
item.description: Researchers used 5 million job postings to study how GenAI exposure affects intra-urban inequality in Beijing.

item.title: Sam Altman softens “AI jobs apocalypse” expectations
item.description: Sam Altman said he no longer expects the kind of near-term jobs apocalypse some AI leaders have predicted.

item.title: Enterprises want agents, but most are not operationally ready
item.description: MIT Technology Review Insights reports a gap between enterprise interest in agentic AI and the infrastructure needed to support it.

item.title: Google AI Overviews stumble on a simple date question
item.description: Google’s AI Overviews reportedly answered “is 2027 next year” incorrectly, citing old social posts about the same error.

item.title: Erin Brockovich launches U.S. AI data center impact map
item.description: Erin Brockovich is tracking U.S. data center projects and local complaints tied to the AI infrastructure boom.

item.title: AI-assisted lawsuits are straining court systems
item.description: The Verge points to reporting that AI-assisted self-filed lawsuits are flooding courts.
